Home

This space explores system design through an agnostic lens, grounded in patterns from 80+ systems built and evolved, a structured consolidation of methods and ongoing inquiry, and a set of cross-domain heuristics for building resilient systems

Loose Coupling

Design systems so that changes in one area do not cascade unpredictably.

Fail Fast

Detect errors quickly and recover gracefully to prevent large-scale failures.

Modular Design

Use modular components that can be tested, replaced, or scaled independently.

Heuristic 1: KISS Principle

Keep designs simple. Avoid over-engineering by focusing on essential functionality first.

Heuristic 2: DRY Principle

Don't repeat yourself. Reuse code and patterns wherever possible.

Heuristic 3: Fail Fast

Detect errors early in the system lifecycle to prevent cascading failures.
